title: Decision Arena replay: /arena, /arena/<case> and /arena/<case>/<decider> compare and play a frozen result
acceptance: /arena/<caseId>/<decider> (openai, jev, kev, rules) loads /content/arena/index.json and its run file only when opened, and plays the first run's admitted decision for that case and decider through the same reading gate, with no model call.
A frozen decision is admitted only under its own label, rise/arena-replay-1 with provider RISE, keeping the original model as sourceModel; other unknown labels are still refused.

Four plain-text deciders (A · OpenAI Decisions, B · TypeSafe Jev, C · Kev, D · rules, no model) switch the same case one reading at a time; a decider with no admitted decision reads 'not run' or 'rejected: <code>' as text; the page states the capture date and that there is no partnership with OpenAI or TypeSafe.

A missing or unreadable index (including the app's HTML page served in its place), a mock-only index, or a case the run lacks shows one plain line and a link (Home, or the case list), not a silent redirect; first load stays within the 64 KB brotli budget.

/arena lists the run's cases by the reader's request; /arena/<case> shows the four deciders' book, look, sound and pace side by side with each served model (sourceModel) beside its label, and a 'Play this one' button per admitted decision.
Seth or Mateo plays a real frozen run at rise.syberlabs.io/arena/<case>/<decider> after the billed capture lands.

summary: Replays frozen Decision Arena results as real readings, one decider at a time. Reads only the harness's slim replay file (PR #532): index runs[] latest non-mock entry's replay, then replay-<sha12>.json (syberlabs.decision-arena-replay/v1: runFile, createdAt, providers, decisions[case][provider] = admitted or {rejectCode}). The fixture src/test/arena-run.fixture.js is the contract; content hashes are checked by the harness, not the browser.
